messages:
alex: Kicking off warmstart for the new eu-central-2 GPU cluster. Putting a minimal kubeadm checklist here for validation and handoff. Will run 3 control-plane nodes + 6 gpu worker nodes (A100s).

alex: Key goals: stable kubeadm init config, driver/daemonset flow, device-plugin, autoscaler rules, base addons (calico, metrics-server, cert-manager), and cost guard rails for spot preemption.

alex: kubeadm snippet I'm planning to use (short):
```yaml
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta3
kind: ClusterConfiguration
kubernetesVersion: "1.28.2"
networking:
  serviceSubnet: "10.96.0.0/12"
  podSubnet: "10.244.0.0/16"
controlPlaneEndpoint: "lb-euc2.redwood.internal:6443"
```

maria: Looks good. Have we pinned the kernel + driver matrix? last time the node images pulled 525.x driver and it conflicted with CUDA 12 lib.

sam: We should add a preflight check job to the bootstrap: verify nvidia-smi present, nvidia-container-runtime installed, and kubelet has --volume-plugin-dir correct. I can paste a quick script.

sam: preflight (bash):
```bash
if ! command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null; then echo "DRIVER MISSING"; exit 1; fi
modinfo nvidia || echo "nvidia kernel module missing"
```

lee: Also check driver/allocator order for MIG. We set the AMIs with MIG disabled for now — simpler autoscaler accounting. If we enable MIG later, need updated device-plugin.

devops-bot: cert-manager helm release "cert-manager-euc2" installed (revision 1) :white_check_mark:

alex: For nodepool labels and taints: plan is label gpu=true, accelerator=nvidia_a100, and taint: dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule. Will add tolerations for runtimes.

maria: For autoscaler, prefer on-demand for base pool and spot for burst gpu pool. Add maxTotalUnready and scale-down delays to avoid churn. Example: 
```yaml
--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m
--expander=least-waste
```

sam: Add cluster-autoscaler helm values: use nodeSelector on k8s.io/arch, set max nodes 12 for spot pool. Also ensure RBAC serviceaccount exists.

lee: Network wise, using Calico in BGP mode. Remember to set ipipMode to "Never" and BGP mesh anchor for control-plane routers. Calico policy will block egress to internal SaaS S3 endpoints until we add NAT gateway.

alex: Storage: default storageclass = gp2-like block, but GPU jobs will use local NVMe ephemeral for scratch. We should document pod annotation for local-storage and eviction threshold.

maria: Cost note: spot A100s reduce run cost ~60% but we saw 15-20% more task restarts. Ops wants a spend cap on the spot pool via a budget alert. Can someone hook that to CloudBilling alert?

sam: I'll add budget alert + prometheus rule for node churn. Also adding metrics-server and node-problem-detector as base addons. Install order suggestion: kube-proxy/ipvs -> calico -> metrics-server -> cert-manager -> device-plugin/driver daemonset -> kubelet label joiners -> cluster-autoscaler.

lee: Quick kubeadm handoff checklist for on-call:
- verify control-plane instances registered on LB
- kubectl get cs + kubectl get nodes | grep NotReady
- kubectl describe daemonset nvidia-driver -n kube-system
- check kubelet logs for cni/dns errors

alex: Minor config I want to include in the doc: kubelet extra args to set eviction threshold (nodefs.inodesFree < 5% -> evict) and kube-reserved for 2 cores on gpu nodes.

devops-bot: kube-proxy helm release "kp-euc2" deployed (ipvs mode) :rocket:

maria: Last thing — handoff owner assigned? Suggest @sam for first 48h oncall, then rotate to eng-sre. Sam ok?

sam: I can take initial 48h. I'll push a short runbook with the troubleshooting commands and a quick run of the preflight script against the images.

alex: Great. I'll update the runbook doc and link AMI IDs, kernel+driver matrix, and cost alert ARNs. After you confirm preflight pass, we tag as ready for partner handoff. :thumbsup:
